subject.statement: Nikola Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in February 2025.

summary: As of 2026-10-01, the claim that Nikola Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in February 2025 is TRUE with 99% confidence. The company, legally named Nikola Corporation and incorporated in Delaware, has its headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona. It filed a voluntary Chapter 11 petition on February 19, 2025 (case number 25-10258) in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware, and the case has since seen a liquidation plan confirmed on September 12, 2025 and an appeal reviewed on September 10, 2026.
